meta_description: Sims Plumbing & Heating in Bolton. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Same-day callouts available. Call 07377 547597.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Bolton? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full system installations, we handle every aspect of residential and commercial plumbing and heating.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most issues on the first visit, day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Expert diagnosis and repair of faulty boilers, plus full system installations with warranty. Keep your home warm and energy efficient.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Complete heating system design, installation, and maintenance. We optimise efficiency to cut your fuel bills and ensure reliable warmth all winter.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Replace cold or corroded radiators, or add new ones to extend comfort throughout your home. Quick turnaround, minimal disruption.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Professional installation of showers, taps, and water supply work for new bathrooms and kitchens. We work closely with builders and decorators.

services.title: Drain Clearance & CCTV Surveys
services.desc: Unblock drains quickly using high-pressure jetting, or identify hidden problems with our camera survey service before costly excavation.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: Sims Plumbing & Heating was founded on a simple idea: treat every job like it's your own home. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Bolton for turning up on time, fixing problems right the first time, and charging honestly. Our team holds Gas Safe registration and carries full public liability insurance.
about_para_2: We work for homeowners, landlords, and property managers who value reliability and transparency. Most of our work now comes from repeat customers and their referrals — the best compliment we can ask for. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned installation, we bring the same professionalism and care every single time.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Saturday morning and was panicking. Called Sims and they were here within 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, tidied up, and the bill was fair. Really impressed. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler installed before winter. Steve and the lad were brilliant — they explained everything, took care around the house, and the boiler's running perfectly. Warm and cosy now. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret P.

reviews.text: Have used Sims three times now for various bits — radiator replacement, blockage, and an annual service. Always professional, always fair pricing. You don't see many honest tradespeople these days but these guys are the real deal.
reviews.author: Paul H.
